description: Read comparable details for 2–5 distinct published products in one category. Preserves input order, unknowns, eligibility and conditional price qualifications. Covers mobile, home internet, current accounts, credit cards, personal loans, electricity, gas and dual. No universal ranking. Energy returns illustrative website bill estimates, not personalized quotes; telecom and banking headline fees exclude other charges. Reuse search inputs in loan or energy context to preserve the same values. Optional price_selections require explicit confirmation of ALL conditions for each selected price option.

connection.description: Home internet only. Reuse the search connection filters to preserve the same connection in details, comparison and website links. Both speeds must match one published profile; address availability is not checked.

profile_id.description: Exact published profile_id. Required when connection filters do not identify a single profile for a profile-specific price.

energy.description: Energy only. Reuse search consumption to retain the same monthly estimate. No address availability check.

annual_kwh.description: Annual electricity consumption. Website default: 2700 kWh.

annual_smc.description: Annual gas consumption. Website default: 1400 Smc.

loan.description: Personal loans only. Reuse the search amount and term; examples are not personalized quotes.

locale.description: Website link language; source terms may remain Italian.

price_selections.description: At most one explicitly confirmed complete price option per compared product.
